name: Ollama
description: Ollama makes it trivially easy to download and run large language models locally on macOS, Linux, and Windows. With a single command, users can run Llama 3, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, Phi, Deepseek, and 100+ other models. Ollama provides a local REST API compatible with OpenAI's API format, making it a drop-in replacement for local development. It handles model management, quantisation, and GPU acceleration automatically.
pricingDetails: Completely free and open source (MIT). You only pay for hardware to run it on.
